saw_lines: Endurance buyers pick fuel by what their stomach tolerates on a long ride, then reorder the same flavor for every session.
So the sale is won or lost in line one, where a rider checking delivery either stays or scrolls past.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 21 Oct 2026
points: Your site explains where you ship, yet 0 of 30 ads mention shipping or delivery, so an unsure buyer has no reason to click. Open three ads with ship-to countries in line one, then test them against your Shop now ads.
None of your 24 fixed-copy ads carries a proof number, so a cold buyer has nothing to check the claim against. Collect one real count, such as reviews or orders shipped, and open two new ads with it.

2 of 24 fixed-copy ads are creator posts, one a cyclist describing a 2:1 fueling routine, and they run from your brand page. Buyers trust riders, so whitelist both from the creator account and cut three variations of that routine.

Your site promotes free shipping above €100 for Eurozone, yet 0 of 24 ads mention it, so new buyers get no reason to order. Put free shipping in line one of three ads, then test them against your Shop now ads.

ads_1: Shipping-first creative for new buyers, with the 2:1 fueling routine as the creator angle
soc_1: Brand social strategy across Facebook and Instagram
